os_network_id.description: Network identifier in the cloud platform.

network_id.description: Parent network identifier in the Global Router service.

gateway.description: Subnet IP address that will be used as gateway on the router. This IP address must be available.  If not specified, the first IP address in subnet range will be used.

cidr.description: Subnet IP address range in CIDR notation.

os_subnet_id.description: Subnet identifier in the cloud platform.

service_addresses.description: Two of the subnet IP addresses that will be reserved as service ones.  These IP addresses must be available. If not specified, the last two IP addresses in subnet range will be reserved.
